messages:
Samir Patel: FYI we've got model artifacts from partner (s3://partners/atlas-6.1/). Need onboarding checks: checksum, tokenizer mapping, license, registry entry. @Nora can you triage? :wave:

Nora Kim: taking. Do we have manifest + signer?

Samir Patel: manifest is in the bucket at s3://partners/atlas-6.1/manifest.yaml — contains filenames, sha256, license string, and 'signed_by' metadata.

Jesse Lee: I'll start checksum + KMS/decrypt steps. Commands I'll run: ```
aws s3 cp s3://partners/atlas-6.1/weights.pt ./ && sha256sum weights.pt
``` Also a quick tokenizer probe: ```
python -c 'from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file("tokenizer.json"); print(t.get_vocab_size())'
```

InfraBot: Note: S3 objects are from external account; cross-account role required. ACL shows private.

ML Ingest Bot: checksum scan scheduled — preliminary result: 1/3 files mismatch (weights.pt) expected 0f1ae3... got 5a2c4b...

Samir Patel: okay, @Jesse re-download and re-run. Also request a signed manifest + signer cert from partner.

Jesse Lee: re-downloading now. If mismatch persists we'll ask partner to re-upload a signed tarball. Also noticed manifest license = "non-commercial" — flagging for legal; this will block enterprise rollout.

Nora Kim: triage checklist (short):
1) verify checksums (sha256) and signers
2) confirm tokenizer format and vocab mapping (hf/tokenizers vs sentencepiece)
3) license & export-control check
4) registry entry with provenance tags + artifact_hash
5) run quick smoke eval (50 prompts) for quality/regression
6) quantization experiment plan (8-bit dynamic, int8 static)
7) schedule canary deployment (dev pool)

Eve Torres: registry tagging convention: model_name=atlas-6.1, source=partner-x, artifact_hash=<sha256>, signing_cert=<sha256sig>, license=non-commercial, received_by=Samir

Jesse Lee: smoke eval command I'll use: ```
./run_eval.sh --model weights.pt --prompts small_eval.json --out out.json
``` small_eval.json = 50 mixed prompts (summ, qa, code).

Samir Patel: quant plan: start with 8-bit dynamic quant on dev GPU, then run int8 static on quantized build. Collect metrics: perplexity, BLEU/ROUGE on subset, latency P50/P95. Compare to fp16 baseline.

Nora Kim: added intake ticket INGEST-2026 in tracker and assigned to Jesse. If partner cannot reupload within 24h treat as blocker.

Jesse Lee: will also request partner provide PGP-signed tarball and their public key. If they can't provide, require re-upload + manifest signed by their account key + S3 object checksums.

ML Ingest Bot: ticket created: INGEST-2026, assignee: Jesse Lee, priority: P1.

Eve Torres: ETA for checksum+smoke eval: ~8h (depends on partner reupload).

Samir Patel: one more ops/security note: any temporary copy into our bucket must use a customer-managed CMK and audit logging enabled.

Jesse Lee: noted. I'll include kms_key_id in the registry entry and mark storage=private.

Samir Patel: great. keep updates in this thread. Closing condition: registry entry created with provenance tags + smoke eval pass. :thumbsup:
